site.name: Black Rose Mine
overview: Black Rose Mine is a documented historic mine locality in Boulder County's Jamestown Mining District. Mineral-locality records place it northwest of Jamestown among the district's dense network of telluride-era workings.

Published locality data record petzite, a gold-silver telluride mineral, at Black Rose Mine and cite major geological studies of Boulder County's ore deposits. Available desk sources do not provide enough reliable, site-specific operational history to support a broader visitor narrative.
moreHistory: Remnant uses the published mine-locality coordinate as a site-level identification point. The source notes that mapped coordinates may be estimated, so this point should not be interpreted as a field-surveyed surviving portal, shaft, or public access route.
Black Rose Mine is distinct from the nearby New Rival–Black Rose locality in the Ward Mining District.
